**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Bullock](../persons.html#221),
I think that with the book of Shropshire worthies I could manage [Fletcher](../persons.html#1677)’s life. [Lady Falkland](../persons.html#2408) is so well done in Miss Kavanagh’s [Women of Christianity](../others.html#91) that I think I could write her from thence.[^1] I suppose you are entirely at sea as to disposing of the book and cannot tell at all what you could allow the writers

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The biographies of the Rev.

John William Fletcher and of Lettice, Viscountess Falkland were among the [\'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans\'](../books.html#358) intended for Bullock\'s Daily Lections project, but were never published.
